description:
Cast Enduring Ideal.
Enduring Ideal is exiled with Eye of the Storm.
Choose to not cast your copy of Enduring Ideal with Eye of the Storm.
Hive Mind triggers, and all other players are forced to cast Enduring Ideal.
All other players may not cast any other spells for the rest of the game because of Enduring Ideal's Epic ability, and they can not use Enduring Ideal due to Stranglehold.
